<function name="PreDrawViewModels" parent="GM" type="hook">
	<added>2020.06.24</added>
	<description>
Called just before all view models (there are 3 per player, see <page>Player:GetViewModel</page>) and entities with `RENDERGROUP_VIEWMODEL` are drawn.

See <page>GM:PreDrawViewModel</page> and <page>GM:PostDrawViewModel</page> for hooks that run for specific view models.

You can use <page>GM:PreDrawEffects</page> as a "`PostDrawViewModels`" hook as it is called just after the all the view model(s) are drawn.

<rendercontext hook="true" type="3D"></rendercontext>
	</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
</function>
